audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Qiyana/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill; the content layer and packet levelChart both read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Orianna. Five of seven rows disagreed, including level 1 handed to the wrong side.
audit.why: 48.32% over 865 games. Level 1 is Orianna's on reach — Command: Attack is 815 against a 525-range Q with no element yet. Levels 4 through first item are Qiyana's: Audacity closes 650 units into an element combo and you have no dash. Two-plus items returns to Orianna in grouped fights.
audit.corrected: All five disagreeing sides moved to the content layer's verdict with whys 0, 3, 4 and 5 rewritten in the same group; phases[6].why already described Orianna winning late.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why said your level 6 doubles your lane presence, on a row that belongs to Qiyana, and breakdown.spikes repeated it.
audit.why: Supreme Display of Talent is 120 seconds at every rank, 950 range, and detonates terrain to stun — the level 6 spike in this lane is hers, and it is conditional on a wall being near you. Orianna's spikes here are Lost Chapter, then two items with Zhonya's.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the flat 120-second terrain stun; breakdown.spikes reframed to name which rows are hers.
sources: enemyKit.R cd 120, range 950, terrain and knockup flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown or range appeared anywhere on the page, and Royal Privilege was never mentioned.
audit.why: Audacity (E, 11/10/9/8/7, 650) is the only way she reaches you and is therefore the lane's timer. Terrashape (W, 7s, 1100) is a long repositioning dash that also enchants her weapon, so she can arrive from further than her E suggests. Supreme Display of Talent (R) is a flat 120s at all three ranks and stuns by detonating terrain, which is why standing in the open matters. Royal Privilege (P) puts bonus damage on her first hit against you, so her opener is her biggest single number.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the do/don't bodies now carry the 11-second dash, the 1100-range W and the flat 120-second ultimate.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, cooldowns and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: Qiyana is female and the full layer called her he/his throughout — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, four phase whys, three do/don't titles and report[0]/[1]/[3]/[4]/[9]/[11]. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were foreign strings pasted under their titles, and dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second' window for an 11-second ability.
audit.why: champ-gender lists qiyana as female. A reader counting fifteen seconds off a spent Audacity walks up four seconds after she can dash again.
audit.corrected: Regendered throughout; the bled bullets rewritten to their titles; the window corrected to eleven seconds.

audit.why: Audacity 11s at rank 1 and the flat 120s ultimate are the two numbers that decide every step forward.

notes: Qiyana is female; the full layer was written for a male enemy and every occurrence is regendered above. Five of seven full-layer chart sides disagreed with the content layer and packet chart — including level 1, which the full layer gave to Qiyana against an 815-versus-525 range gap. Content was right; only full sides move, with the four affected whys rewritten alongside. dosFull[2].d promised a fifteen-second window on an ability with an 11-second rank-1 cooldown; corrected. Not asserted: the camouflage and per-element effects the content layer references (brush camouflage, river slow, rock stun) are not in Riot's text in the kit file, so I left that inherited wording alone rather than building new claims on it. phases[N].rating untouched — the scale is inconsistent across this dataset.
